title: feat(spec)!: object extension fieldPatches refuse a field the extension replaces, key option patches by value, refuse __proto__, carry display renames
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9LXi8jnV2NzztvoFy8gqAqx)_
Fixes #28655

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` gains the "Patch it or take it over, not both" bullet (the replaced-field refusal and the option-key grammar). `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` already teaches "Relabel a field the owner declares with `fieldPatches` — never by redeclaring it in `fields`" and its example keys the option by `technology`, so every taught line stays true and no skill line changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象扩展的 `fieldPatches` 多拒三种输入——同一扩展既在 `fields` 里整字段替换又在 `fieldPatches` 里打补丁的字段、不可能是选项值的选项补丁键(如 `Tech Sector`)、以及 `__proto__` 键;补丁上写 `helpText`/`title` 这类别名时给出改名提示;描述里的白名单成员改为从常量生成。
- 为什么改:`fieldPatches` 现在已被合并真实应用,原来这些写法"能保存、不生效":补丁落在扩展自己的替换字段上,或永远匹配不到选项,`__proto__` 键在保存门被存下却在注册时丢失。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING,spec minor)。仓内 examples/skills/docs 无一处命中被拒写法;回滚即 revert 本 PR。HotCRM 仓不在本容器,未测。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`(`refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField`、`options` 的键 schema、`whitelistedAliases`)、`packages/spec/src/data/field-key-aliases.ts`(别名表搬出的唯一副本)、`packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts` 新增一节。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-customization.test.ts src/data/field-patches-derived.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件全绿(91 条)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

All in `ObjectExtensionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`), the four should-fixes A–D of the contract review on PR #28650:

- **A.** The root `superRefine` refuses a field name present in both `fields` and `fieldPatches` of one extension (`refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField`): `custom` at `fieldPatches.NAME`, prescribing "patch the vendor's field or declare your own, not both". A `__c` name in both is left to the existing `__c` rule, so it is refused once.
- **B.** A field patch's `options` map is keyed by `SelectOptionSchema.shape.value` (read off the shape, not restated), so `Tech Sector` is refused with `invalid_key` at `fieldPatches.industry.options.Tech Sector`. `refuseRecordProtoKey` now guards `fields`, `fieldPatches` and the `options` map: the measurement holds at the door (below), not only at schema level.
- **C.** The field patch and the option patch carry the rows of their source shape's rename table whose target the whitelist admits, by filter (`whitelistedAliases`). Field: `title`, `displayName` onto `label`; `help`, `helpText`, `hint`, `tooltip` onto `inlineHelpText`. Option: `text`, `name`, `title` onto `label`. Carriage follows the `ui/action-target-aliases.ts` precedent: the two tables moved out of `field.zod.ts` into a relative-import-only leaf, `packages/spec/src/data/field-key-aliases.ts`, which `FieldSchema`, `SelectOptionSchema` and the patches all read. No second mechanism and no new public export (`check:api-surface` unchanged).
- **D.** The `fieldPatches` `.describe()` lists its members from `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST` (`fieldPatchesDescription`).

Generated and ledger files that ride along:

- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` (regenerated description);
- `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: the five `data/ObjectExtension` `fields.valueType…` sites moved to `fields.out.valueType…`, because the `__proto__` guard wraps the record in a preprocess. The same sites, one level deeper, and no new site;
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` gains one bullet;
- `.changeset/28655-field-patches-refuse-replaced-field.md`.

Forced test edits: none. The new pins are added to `field-customization.test.ts` and `field-patches-derived.test.ts`. No existing assertion changed.

## Why

The card's "reach: none yet" premise has expired: `mergeObjectDefinitions` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) applies `fieldPatches` on main (#28565). Each input A and B refuse parsed and then did nothing visible. A patch landed on the extension's own whole-field replacement, and an option key no value can be never matched an option.

`__proto__` reach, measured at the door on main `47ee57fe` before the change. This is the `/api/v1/meta` `object_extension` save door's own schema (`OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_SCHEMA`) and its registration seam (`registrableObjectExtension`), over a JSON-parsed body:

- the door schema answered `success: true`, with `fields: {}` and `fieldPatches` missing the key;
- the registered body was missing it too;
- the stored (verbatim) body kept `fieldPatches.__proto__` and `fields.__proto__`. The stored row and the served extension disagree.

## Tests

The new pins, each giving zod code, path and named subject beside a control through the same parse:

- A: refusal at `fieldPatches.industry`, with a control (a patch beside a `fields` entry of another name parses), and the `__c` case refused once.
- B: `invalid_key` at the option key, with a control (the key verdict equals `SelectOptionSchema.shape.value.safeParse` for four keys). There are three `__proto__` cases (`fields`, `fieldPatches`, `options`) over JSON documents, plus a control.
- C: four field renames and three option renames, with a control (a rename whose target the patch refuses carries no arrow, and `colour` carries none under the shipped whitelist). The derived proof is in `field-patches-derived.test.ts`: once the mocked whitelist admits `color`, the option's `colour` rename reaches the patch.
- D: every whitelist member appears in the description, and the widened members appear under the mock.

Ablation, in a side worktree at `5f8d7494`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (each anchor 1 → 0, every leg restored to blob `67228dde3fe9`, `git diff HEAD` empty). Spec tests import `src`, so no build is in the path:

| leg | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | drop the `refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField` call | 1 (the A refusal) |
| B key | `z.string()` key instead of `optionShape.value` | 2 (refusal + grammar control) |
| B proto | drop the `fieldPatches` guard | 1 (the `fieldPatches` `__proto__` case) |
| C field | drop the field patch `aliases` | 4 (the four field renames) |
| C option | drop the option patch `aliases` | 3 (the three option renames) |
| D | constant description | 3 (both description pins + the existing liveness pin) |

## Acceptance notes

- The card listed the field renames as `title`, `help`, `helpText`, `hint`, `tooltip`. The filter also yields `displayName` onto `label`, which `FieldSchema`'s table carries. It is pinned.
- The `options` map's `__proto__` guard goes beyond the card's "`fieldPatches` and `fields`". It is the same defect class and the same mechanism, in the same schema, inside the same gate family. Without it B's key grammar could not see that key, because zod skips `__proto__` before the key schema.
- The claim's file surface names `object.zod.ts`. C also touches `field.zod.ts` (the two tables now read from the leaf, byte-identical rows) and adds `field-key-aliases.ts`. This is declared as a deviation for the seat to amend.
- HotCRM fixtures: that repository is not reachable from this container, so its count of A/B hits is NOT MEASURED. In this repository, examples/, skills/ and content/docs/ carry zero refused forms. The only authored `fieldPatches` (the docs page and the skill) key options by `technology`.
- `refuseUnlessPlatformWritten` and `mergeObjectDefinitions` are untouched (#28205 follows in the same file).
